Minutes. Recommendation: Approve minutes of regular meeting on November 24, 2014 as written.
D-1. Nov 24 UB Minutes
2.
Acceptance of Grant of Permanent Easement for Water Utility Purposes from Property Owner Rosedale Land Partners II LLC for Tract 54057-21 Portions of Lot C & E. Recommendation: Accept the Grant of Permanent Easement by Resolution UB-1-2015 for Water Utility purposes for Tract 54057-21 portions of Lot C and E in the City of Azusa and authorize the City Clerk to file said easement documents with the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD/CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA ACCEPTING A CERTAIN GRANT OF PERMANENT EASEMENT AND DIRECTING THE RECORDING THEREOF

Acceptance of Grant of Permanent Easement for Water Utility Purposes from Property Owner Tacos El Gavilan for 887 S. Azusa Avenue. Recommendation: Accept the Grant of Permanent Easement by Resolution UB-2-2015 for Water Utility purposes for the property, Tacos El Gavilan, located at 887 S. Azusa Avenue in the City of Azusa and authorize the City Clerk to file said easement documents with the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD/CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA ACCEPTING A CERTAIN GRANT OF PERMANENT EASEMENT AND DIRECTING THE RECORDING THEREOF

4.
Approval of Notice of Completion for the Installation of Project W-276, Truck Storage Shed, at the Gladstone Yard. Recommendation: Accept the Storage Shed Project W-276, approve the Notice of Completion, and direct the City Clerk's Office to execute the Notice of Completion, and record and file it at the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder.
D-4.1. NOC Truck Shed W-276 Gladstone Yard
D-4.2. W-276 NOC Truck Shed Form
5.
Approval of Notice of Completion for Project W-281 Installation of Sludge Drying Bed Improvements at Hsu Canyon Water Treatment Plant. Recommendation: Accept Project W-281, approve the Notice of Completion and direct the City Clerk's Office to execute the Notice of Completion, and record and file it at the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder.
D-5.1. NOC W-281 WTP Sludge Retrofilt
D-5.2. NOC W-281 NOC Sludge Retrofit Form
6.
Approve Lease of City Property at the Dalton Reservoir Site to T-Mobile for a Cell Phone Communications Tower. Recommendation: Approve a lease to T-Mobile West Corporation at a price of $2,600 per month for a portion of City Property at the Dalton Reservoir site for a cell phone tower and authorize the City Manager to execute the lease agreement as approved by the City Attorney.
D-6.1. T-Mobile Lease Dalton Reservoir
D-6.2. T-Mobile Lease Agreement Dalton Reservoir
D-6.3. T-Mobile Memo of Agreement Dalton Reservoir
7.
Approval to Hire Stetson Engineers to Prepare Discharge Permit Applications to Test Pump Aspan Well. Recommendation: Approve the selection of Stetson Engineers to prepare a discharge application necessary to test pump Azusa Light & Water's Aspan Well.
D-7.1. Stetson Discharge Permit
D-7.2. Stetson Proposal
8.
Waive Formal Bidding Procedures and Award Purchase of One (1) Ford F150 Pickup Truck and One (1) Ford F350 Pickup Truck to Downtown Ford Sales Under California Multiple Award Schedule (CMAS). Recommendation: Waive formal sealed bids in accordance with AMC Section 2-522, sub-section C, and award the purchase of one (1) Ford F150 pickup truck for $22,333.01 and one (1) Ford F-350 pickup truck for $38,313.96 to Downtown Ford Sales under the California Multiple Award Schedule (CMAS Contract No. 1-08-23-20) in the total amount of $60,646.97 including tax and delivery.
D-8.1. Award CMAS Truck Purchase
D-8.2. Ford Truck Proposals
9.
Approve Purchase of a Sleeve Valve for the Interconnection Line Between the SGVMWD Water Pipeline and the Hsu-Canyon Water Treatment Plant Project W-280. Recommendation: Approve the purchase a 14-inch Bailey sleeve valve for the future supplemental water supply line to the Hsu-Canyon Water Treatment Plant and approve the attached Resolution UB-3-2015 authorizing a budget amendment of $170,000 in the Water Fund. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD/CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR FY 2014/15 BUDGET IN THE WATER UTILITY FUND IN THE AMOUNT OF $170,000
D-9.1. Proj W-280 Purchase Sleeve Valve
D-9.2. Resolution Proj W-280 Budget Amendment
D-9.3. Civiltec Letter To ALW - Flow Control Valve R1
10.
Approval of San Juan Unit 3 Energy Exchange and Firming Arrangement Between Azusa and Arizona Public Service Company (APS). Recommendation: Authorize Staff to renew the energy exchange and firming arrangement for San Juan Unit 3 with Arizona Public Service (APS) for the period of February 1, 2015 through December 31, 2015 and authorize the Director of Utilities to execute the associated final agreement with APS.
D-10.1. San Juan Firming and Exchange
D-10.2. Draft 2015 Azusa Energy Exchange
D-10.3. Draft 2015 Interim Azusa Energy Exchange Confirm

Acceptance of Grant of Easement from Property Owner at 547 E. 10th Street, Azusa, CA 91702. Recommendation: Accept the Grant of Easement by attached Resolution UB-4-2015 for the Property located at 547 East 10th Street in City of Azusa, owned by Thalia Corona and authorize the City Clerk to file the easement documents in the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD/CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA ACCEPTING A CERTAIN GRANT OF PERMANENT EASEMENT AND DIRECTING THE RECORDING THEREOF
